summary: Added src/settings.js (DEFAULT_SETTINGS), src/window.js (holdEnd, holdEndWords, windowWords) and test/window.test.js with the T-5 and T-21 witnesses plus custom-window and time-zone tests (London, Auckland, Kiritimati). The tests pass under TZ=Pacific/Auckland and the witness-check passes. Changes are uncommitted.
notes: holdEnd takes the window's end day to be the last entry of days and finds the first such day whose `to` instant is strictly after now. A window ending exactly at `now` has ended.
Time words: on the hour uses words (midnight, noon, 'six'); other times use a form like '5:30pm'.
Clock-change tests set process.env.TZ at run time. London and Kiritimati only run in the full run; the witness lane's own TZ is Auckland.
